description: Source code for a Zephyr RTOS driver implementing a counter interface for NXP i.MX SNVS (Secure Non-Volatile Storage) hardware, supporting high-power and optionally low-power RTC alarms.

methods.name: mcux_snvs_start
methods.description: Stub function indicating the counter is already started.

methods.name: mcux_snvs_stop
methods.description: Stub function indicating stopping is not supported.

methods.name: mcux_snvs_get_value
methods.description: Reads the current counter value from hardware registers.

methods.name: mcux_snvs_set_alarm
methods.description: Sets an alarm callback for a specified channel and alarm configuration.

methods.name: mcux_snvs_cancel_alarm
methods.description: Cancels an active alarm callback for a specified channel.

methods.name: mcux_snvs_get_pending_int
methods.description: Returns pending interrupt flags for RTC and SRTC alarms.

methods.name: mcux_snvs_isr
methods.description: Interrupt Service Routine handling RTC and SRTC alarm interrupts, invoking callbacks.

methods.name: mcux_snvs_rtc_set
methods.description: Sets the RTC counter value, synchronizing high and low power timers.

methods.name: mcux_snvs_init
methods.description: Initializes the SNVS RTC hardware, configures clocks, and sets up interrupts.
